levels.surface: عبد اللّه بن ميمون القدّاح المكّيّ

notes: three routes for the book, no saying in this text; the father's own chain to Ibn Maymun is not written, so the first route is the text's own step «رويته عن أبي» with the content «عن عبد اللّه بن ميمون»
the second «رويته عن أبي» repeats the first teacher and is not counted as a separate route; «- رضي اللّه عنهم -» blessings are left out
